notes: Redistribution verdict for every runtime SDK SolarScribe can load. Only an SDK with redistributable=true is copied into a release bundle by prepare_vendor.py. Changing a verdict is a legal decision: update the matching file under installer/licenses/ as well.

asi.name: ZWO ASI Camera SDK
asi.evidence: ASI_Camera_SDK/ASI_Windows_SDK_V1.41.zip and ASI_Camera_SDK/ASI_linux_mac_SDK_V1.41.tar.bz2 both contain license.txt: MIT text with Copyright (c) 2015, ZWO Company. The notice must travel with the binaries.

playerone.name: Player One Camera SDK
playerone.license: Player One SDK licence (permission to use and redistribute with notice)
playerone.evidence: PlayerOne_Camera_SDK_Linux_V3.10.1/license.txt says the SDK may be used to develop any products without restrictions, provided the copyright notice and permission notice are included in all copies.

qhy.name: QHYCCD Camera SDK and firmware
qhy.license: No licence file and no written redistribution grant found
qhy.evidence: The Linux SDK archive qhyccdsdk-v2.0.11-Linux-Debian-Ubuntu-x86_64.tar.gz contains no LICENSE or COPYING file, and the GitHub delivery repository carries no licence. Default position for software with no written grant is all rights reserved.

toupcam.name: ToupTek ToupCam SDK
toupcam.license: No licence file and no written redistribution grant found
toupcam.evidence: toupcamsdk.20261024.zip contains no LICENSE or COPYING file in any directory; toupcam.h carries no copyright notice. The SDK is proprietary and the archive grants no redistribution right.

ascom.name: ASCOM Platform
ascom.why: Windows mount backend. It is a separate installation, not redistributed. The installer detects it and the app degrades to the mount simulator when it is absent.

indiserver.name: INDI (indiserver)
indiserver.why: Linux mount backend. It is a distribution package (LGPL-2.1-or-later / GPL-2.0-or-later), not redistributed. The installer recommends indi-bin and the app says what is missing.

dotnet.name: .NET runtime required by the ASCOM Platform
dotnet.why: Part of the ASCOM Platform prerequisite on Windows; SolarScribe does not redistribute it.
